## Manager.close() method

Releases every driver that was actually resolved.

**Signature:**

```typescript
close(): Promise<void>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;void&gt;

A promise that settles once every resolved driver is closed.

## Remarks

Drivers that were never built are skipped, so closing a manager nobody used costs nothing and never opens a connection just to shut it again. A driver that failed to start has nothing to release and is ignored.
